{/* Poixe provides a vendor panel for connecting your own **API quota and resources** to the platform as one of the upstream sources for user requests. The platform handles unified access and scheduling, and you can manage resources and view consumption and earnings data in the vendor panel. */}

Poixe provides developers with a unified AI model API, and also operates an open **upstream resource pool**.

You can apply to become a vendor and connect your API quota and resources to the platform to provide capacity to the system. Poixe handles unified integration, routing, and settlement, while you maintain resources in the vendor panel and view call consumption and revenue data, maximizing quota utilization and growing your earnings.

## What vendors can do

As a vendor, you can connect surplus model API resources (for example, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, DeepSeek, and others) to Poixe:

* **Provide resources**: Submit API keys / account configurations so the platform can call them as an upstream
* **Monetize surplus quota**: Turn idle call capacity into revenue
* **Data visualization**: View consumption, revenue, call statistics, and channel status in the dashboard
* **Pricing per platform rules**: Configure buyback prices / settlement rules (subject to what the panel actually offers)

Poixe distributes user requests across multiple available resources to ensure overall availability and capacity.

## Onboarding process

1. **Understand the vendor mechanism**
   We recommend first reading the vendor overview page to confirm your resource type and use case:
   [https://poixe.com/products/vendor](https://poixe.com/products/vendor)

2. **Submit an onboarding application**
   Fill in the application form (basic information, resource type, additional notes, etc.):
   [https://poixe.com/products/vendor/application](https://poixe.com/products/vendor/application)

3. **Platform review**
   The platform performs the necessary review and confirmation of your application. Once approved, your account is granted access to the vendor panel.

4. **Enter the vendor panel and add resources**
   Once enabled, go to the vendor dashboard (entry: [https://poixe.com/vendor](https://poixe.com/vendor)) to create and maintain your API resource configurations.
   Common resources include:

   * OpenAI API Key
   * Azure OpenAI (Endpoint / Deployment / Key, etc.)
   * Resources from other vendors such as DeepSeek

## Vendor benefits (Tier)

Vendors also have a benefits system (Tier), which reflects their priority and credit assessment on the platform.

New vendors start at **Tier 0** by default, and the system adjusts it automatically afterward.
